rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for rescuing someone or saving something from being lost or destroyed.

example.english: We need to salvage this shipment quickly before it gets soaked and ruined.
example.traditional: 我哋快啲救返呢批貨，唔好畀佢哋浸爛。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 faai3 di1 gau3 faan2 ni1 pai1 fo3 m4 hou2 bei2 keoi5 dei6 zam3 laan6

rows.note: Use this for reclaiming materials or discarded items so they can be reused, rather than for rescuing people.

example.english: We can salvage these old plastic bottles and reuse them.
example.traditional: 呢啲舊膠樽可以回收再用。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 gau6 gaau1 zeon1 ho2 ji5 wui4 sau1 zoi3 jung6

rows.note: Use this when the salvage involves refurbishing or restoring an item so it becomes usable again.

example.english: After refurbishing it, we can salvage this old table and keep using it.
example.traditional: 呢張舊枱翻新之後，又可以繼續用喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 gau6 ci4 faan1 san1 zi1 hau6 jau6 ho2 ji5 gai3 zuk6 jung6 laa3
